author: Ortea & Caballer, 2002

note.en: A tiny aeolid described in 2002 from Manzanillo material. Some sources treat it as a synonym of Eubranchus conicla. Known here from one 2002 specimen taken about 1 km north-west of Manzanillo; the size shown is that of E. conicla.
note.es: Un nudibranquio eólido diminuto descrito en 2002 con material de Manzanillo. Algunas fuentes lo tratan como sinónimo de Eubranchus conicla. Conocido aquí por un ejemplar de 2002 tomado a cerca de 1 km al noroeste de Manzanillo; el tamaño indicado es el de E. conicla.

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2002)
Ortea & Caballer 2002, Avicennia 15, describes it from Manzanillo

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
